original.target_description: Experiment 3: calculation (time/money versus control) by compensation, with enjoyment of music and impatience as separate outcomes; results on published p. 471 / PDF p. 6.

notes: Published article copy. Both assigned originals have identical descriptions and locator p. 6. That page prints compensation main effects and calculation-by-compensation interactions for BOTH enjoyment and impatience, as well as simple effects. Neither description identifies an outcome or contrast. Replication table1/table2 labels alone do not map these original tests without reading an unassigned source. Thus no unique partial eta-squared / p pair can be assigned independently, and row order is not used to guess. Rendered PDF p. 6 checked; canonical text is available, not absent.
